services.name: Bass Fishing
services.desc: This river fishes a little different than most on the Eastern Shore. There are a lot of docks, pads and drop offs but water color usually determines how far down river you can fish. The fishing is so good here you could launch your boat and fish all day without starting the outboard. The spawn is always great fishing
